p: of thy fathers giveth thee to: By which they are admonished to seek no other God.
groves with fire: In which they sacrificed to their idols.
not do so unto the LORD: You shall not serve the Lord with superstitions.
offerings of your hand: Meaning, the first fruits.
before the LORD your God: Where his Ark shall be.
here this day: Not that they sacrificed after their fantasies, but that God would be served more purely in the land of Canaan.
rest from all your enemies round: It was not enough to conquer unless God maintained them in rest under his protection.
choose in one of thy tribes: As was declared ever by the placing of the ark in Shiloh 243 years, or as some write more that 300 years, and in other places till the temple was built.
blessing of the LORD thy God: As God has given you power and ability.
as of the roebuck: Everyone may eat equally at home the beast appointed for sacrifice and the other.
tithe of thy corn: Meaning, whatever was offered to the Lord, may not be eaten, except where he had appointed.
is the life: Because the life of beasts is in their blood.
holy things which thou hast: That which you will offer in sacrifice.
well with thee: God by promise binds himself to do good to those who obey his word.
snared by following them: By following their superstitions and idolatries, and thinking to serve me by it.
burnt in the fire to their: They held nothing too dear to offer to their idols.
